description: This file implements the QuicPollEventLoop class, which manages socket event registration, polling, and alarm handling for QUIC protocol operations within the Chromium project. It includes methods for socket registration, event processing, alarm scheduling, and callback invocation.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop
classes.description: Manages socket event polling, alarm scheduling, and callback execution for QUIC networking.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::Alarm
classes.description: Represents a scheduled alarm within the event loop.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::AlarmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Alarm instances.

methods.name: RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with specified events and listener.

methods.name: RearmSocket
methods.description: Re-enables specified events for a socket.

methods.name: ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Manually triggers an event notification for a socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs one iteration of the event loop, processing alarms and IO events.

methods.name: ComputePollTimeout
methods.description: Calculates the timeout duration for poll based on alarms and pending events.

methods.name: PollWithRetries
methods.description: Performs poll syscall with retries on EINTR.

methods.name: ProcessIoEvents
methods.description: Processes IO events after polling, dispatching callbacks.

methods.name: DispatchIoEvent
methods.description: Prepares a callback for a socket event based on poll results.

methods.name: RunReadyCallbacks
methods.description: Executes all callbacks for ready sockets.

methods.name: ProcessAlarmsUpTo
methods.description: Runs all alarms scheduled up to a certain time.
